chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch 244 – Li Huowang's Flesh Is No Longer His Own
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang escapes a petty killer, only to be pulled into a pit by a living serpent of tassels. When he emerges, his hand is no longer human.
og_title: The Tassel Serpent & the Fleshy Claw
og_description: Li Huowang's quick kill turns into a nightmare descent. What crawls out is no longer entirely human.
twitter_title: Li Huowang's final ascension is a fall
twitter_description: He climbs out of the pit, but his hand is a twisted, tassel-fused claw. The horror of Chapter 244 is here.
